_readme: Hand-picked Pinterest inspiration for Promo Suggestions. Key = product code (e.g. cake00KA001234), or the lower-cased pick name / category path. Each pin: url (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/<id>/), style (Poster | Editorial | Metaphor | Flat-lay | Festive | Lifestyle ...), note (why it fits, one line). Aim for 2-3 pins per pick and MIX styles - never three of the same look.

ef_pc_home0v1624p00003.note: Real product shots arranged into a Christmas-tree shape on one solid colour. For us: the 14 crochet ornaments become the tree. Keep headroom for the logo (max 110px from top).
"From a Seed." Handmade wooden pieces with one confident serif headline and a small "one-of-a-kind" line. Voice and layout for a locally handmade product post.
One small product placed on a natural prop (driftwood, stone) with lots of empty space. How to make a tiny handmade item feel premium without clutter.

chocolates.note: The Cacao Pods: a 7-slide carousel whose cover shows gift boxes with a short, confident headline ("The kind of gift you don't forget"). Same product type as ours (boxed chocolates) and the right carousel structure.
Hands opening a gold chocolate box with a warm line and an "Order Now" button. A human gifting slide that sells the occasion, not just the box.
Cross-product (beauty gift guide): one product on a soft background with its name and price. Layout for one gift box per slide showing Rs price.

*divine coffee cake.note: One slice on a fork against flat burgundy with a single gold accent. Product only, no props: lets the cake and coffee tones do the work.
"Looking for a sweet escape?" answers the search intent directly, then shows the slice. Copy voice for a post aimed at people already searching for coffee cake.
Cake slice beside a cup of coffee: shows the use (a coffee-time treat), which is the reason the term is growing.

*labubu.note: Bold orange poster, big "celebrate" type over a cake. Sets the playful, collectible tone for a Labubu-themed topper.
Illustrated stickers placed on a cake like toppers. Shows how small themed pieces read as the star of the cake.
Cut-out character toppers sold as a set, shot flat. Layout for presenting a topper as a cheap, easy upgrade to a home cake.

*fashion > umbrellas.note: "We've got you covered": a pun printed on the umbrella itself. Fits a post timed to the Colombo rain forecast.
"Because lightness is luxury": one product, one line, lots of space. Makes a compact, low-price umbrella feel considered.
Trench coat and black umbrella on a wet street, shot in muted tones. Mood for the everyday-in-the-rain lifestyle slide.

*seraphina.note: A small pink bouquet on a pedestal with a single short line, warm kraft background. Answers "small pink rose bouquet" with calm confidence.
One bouquet shown large with smaller thumbnails below. Layout for showing the mixed roses and chrysanthemum options.
Torn kraft paper opening to flowers. A "this is what you searched for" reveal for the cover.

*pomegranate.note: Pomegranate seeds laid out as a colour swatch with a label. A clever, graphic way to present an everyday fruit.
Four-frame editorial layout (hand, halves, plate, seeds) that works as a swipe carousel.
Hands holding pomegranate halves on a solid red field. Simple, strong single-colour hero.

*blush bloom.note: "If you like roses": one rose, big headline, carousel format. Answers the "single flower" search with a single flower.
One rose on a white block with a hard shadow. Clean, premium, and easy to copy with a real product photo.
A "buy her flowers" sign set among real flowers. A playful nudge that turns a Rs 1,500 single rose into a quick gift.

*caravan fresh cashew.note: A hand reaching into a pouch on bold red: appetite and "easy small treat" in one frame.
Spiced cashews and chillies flying around the logo on a soft background. Shows crunch and flavour without a busy layout.
"Team salted or team raw": a playful either-or that suits a self-purchase snack.

*diabetasol.note: Bottles balanced on a stone: "Balance inside, glow outside". A balance metaphor that suits a blood-sugar product. Keep claims to what the pack says.
A basket of fresh food with supplements among it: "a basket of better habits". Positions the tin as part of a routine.
A clean product card saying how and when to take it ("1 capsule daily with a meal"). A layout for the serving and usage line.

*fruitbaskets > fruit basket.note: Hands tying a fruit-and-flower basket: "a gift for two hearts". Sells the act of giving.
A woven basket on cream with a short "quiet luxury" line. Premium copy voice for a gift under Rs 4,500.
Fruit box shot from above with strong colour. A layout for showing what is inside.

*crimson embrace.note: Red roses wrapped in a magazine page and white paper. Shows the bouquet as a styled object.
"It's kinda chic to" with a handwritten tag on a vase of red roses. A message-led cover that is not tied to one season.
"If you don't know what to say, send them flowers" over red roses. Copy voice for a proven gift seller.

*mini and bento.note: A dictionary-style "Bento cake (noun)" post. Explains the product in one line; ideal for a category page post.
A single small cake on a grey background held in one hand. Shows the size and the gift-in-hand feel.
Mini cakes with short printed notes, aimed at gifting to a partner or friend. Idea: a short message on each cake.

*java premium chocolate assortment.note: Overhead of a full truffle box with a hand reaching in. Shows the number and variety of a 25-piece box.
A wrapped box with twine and loose truffles on a warm background. A gifting-first layout.
Diagonal box layout with a glimpse of the pieces inside. Graphic, rich, and easy to rebuild with a real box photo.

_standard: Every pick: 1) read the post brief and what the product is, 2) search specific brand/campaign terms (Instagram, art direction), Less AI on, scroll past the first screen, 3) 3 pins with 3 different jobs (composition / copy-voice / staging or carousel structure), cross-product allowed, 4) no season styling unless the product is seasonal, 5) real product photos only: references are for layout, never for restyling the product.
